text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser gets injured during
training,
so I bring her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for worrying you. It doesn't seem
like that
big a deal, though.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Let's head back to the track.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
It's fine! I mean, sure, my nose might
bleed, I
could break into a fever, or
even hives... But I just
know I've got
more energy than anyone!
choice_data_list: もう走るつもりなのか？

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Plus, I can't just sit around resting while
everyone
else is out there working!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I had a feeling you'd say that...
choice_data_list: 今はちゃんと休むべき
わかった、無理のない範囲でやろう

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
But it's times like these that I have to
work hard,
or I'll just stay ordinary
forever...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
choice_data_list: 何かあったら普通にもなれないよ

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'll get plenty of rest today so
that my
injury heals faster.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser sounds slightly

disappointed, but she returns to her
dorm.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Okay! I'll be nice and careful while I run!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... The injury from earlier is hurting
again... I
guess I got a little ahead of
myself...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I'm really sorry, Trainer, but I guess I'm
going to
have to pack it up for the day...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser sounds regretful,
but returns
to her dorm.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I think I can do this as long as I
don't go
all out!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's go! I'll keep things
reasonable, just
like you said! Mun!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser stays mindful of her
injury
and trains comfortably within her
limits.
